papers.title: Prompt-agnostic Language Models
papers.summary: Despite their strong performance, large language models remain highly sensitive to prompt formulation. This issue is typically addressed at inference-time through manual prompt optimization, which introduces overhead and lacks scalability. Conversely, we focus on train-time approaches that build prompt robustness into the model during instruction tuning. A common strategy is to mix multiple paraphrases of each prompt into training. We demonstrate that across trainable parameters, the per-paraphrasing gradients interfere, with 57% exhibiting sign conflicts and the naive gradient average discarding approximately a fifth of the magnitude. Therefore, we develop two gradient-merging methods, Prompt-TIES and Prompt-DARE, that address this interference by leveraging interference-resolution operators from model and gradient merging and applying them to prompt gradients. In this study, we compare the efficacy of our methods to increase model robustness to train-time robustness methods spanning all three established classes: data construction, consistency regularization, and contrastive alignment. The evaluation is conducted across four models from two families at two scales. We observe the interaction between prompt phrasing and the specific examples accounts for 54% of per-example variability on average, and exceeds 70% on tasks such as ANLI and WiC. The gradient-merging methods directly improve this local robustness and nearly halve per-example variance on fully fine-tuned models at little cost to overall accuracy. The other train-time methods enhance raw performance, but fail to improve per-example variance reliably. Code: https://github.com/FSadrieh/prompt-agnostic-llms. Model checkpoints: https://huggingface.co/prompt-agnostic-language-models.
papers.title_ja: プロンプト非依存型言語モデル
papers.summary_ja: 大規模言語モデル（LLM）がプロンプトの表現に敏感である問題に対し、推論時ではなく学習時の手法で解決する研究である。パラフレーズ間の勾配干渉を定量的に分析し、57%で符号競合が発生することを実証した。この干渉を解消するため、モデルマージ技術から着想を得た勾配マージ手法「Prompt-TIES」と「Prompt-DARE」を提案する。既存のデータ構築や正則化手法と比較し、本手法はモデルの局所ロバストネスを向上させ、個々の例における出力変動を半減させることを示した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMの効率化・推論安定化に直結する学習時最適化手法であり、実務応用性が高い。

papers.title: Bouba Beats Kiki, and Other Regularities in the Subjective Preferences of LLMs
papers.summary: Users engage with large language models on tasks that are purely objective ("When was Netflix founded?"), purely subjective ("What should I name my child?") or anywhere in-between. We have rich tools for evaluating model accuracy with respect to objective criteria. However, when it comes to subjective aspects of a task, we do not have similarly developed methodology at hand. In this paper, we take some early steps towards framing the question of subjective evaluation. Rather than measure how often a model is right or wrong on a question, we instead ask, how do models make choices among multiple viable responses without a clear winner? To study this question, we restrict our focus to short-form content, and consider comparison tasks among three such content types: numbers, baby names, and fictional cities. We identify 29 aspects of these short-form examples covering many areas of syntax and semantics (length, alphabetic order, popularity, vowel mix, spoken sound, etc.). We show first that models tend to have strong and reproducible preferences for or against some of these aspects. Second, we show that variations in how the model is asked to express a preference may cause some of these aspects to activate or deactivate in the model's selection. Third, we show that overall preference distributions among pairs may vary radically based on seemingly-unimportant variations in the nature of the question posed to the model, raising new questions about manipulation. And finally, we show that, if models are used both to create lists of alternatives and to rank them, there are unexpected interactions between the two stages that may also drive the models' stated preferences.
papers.title_ja: ブーバとキキ、およびLLMの主観的選好におけるその他の規則性
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、大規模言語モデル（LLM）の主観的な判断や選好のメカニズムを分析するものである。数値、赤ちゃんの名前、架空の都市などの短いコンテンツを対象に、長さや音韻など29の側面からモデルの選好傾向を調査した。その結果、モデルには再現性のある強い選好が存在し、質問の表現方法やリスト生成とランキングの段階的な相互作用によって、その選好が劇的に変化する可能性があることを示した。これにより、LLMの主観的評価における新たな課題や操作のリスクが浮き彫りになっている。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMの挙動分析と評価手法の改善に直結するため

papers.title: What a Weight Update Buys: Leverage Across Training Stages
papers.summary: Post-training moves a language model's weights by about a thousandth of their norm and changes its behavior sharply; pretraining moves them by a third and buys a slow drift. We introduce leverage, an exact measure of what a unit of weight change buys: the Fisher quadratic form of an update, computed with one forward-mode pass per direction, divided by the same form for random directions of the same size at the same checkpoint. Leverage orders released Olmo-3, T\"ulu-3, Zephyr, and OLMo-2 checkpoints over four orders of magnitude: pretraining windows sit at the random level on prose, SFT five times above it, RL-Zero and RLVR at 400-1,500, and DPO at 400-23,000. With this instrument we find that pretraining accumulates into noise: windows of 30k to 1M steps are no more consequential on prose than random directions of their size, as a noisy quadratic model of SGD predicts. We find that training precision changes what an update looks like: training bf16 parameters without an fp32 master copy freezes 36-99% of coordinates, lowers leverage up to sevenfold, and creates an alignment between update magnitudes and the diagonal Fisher that fp32 training does not show. We derive and verify a law for reuse: the sign-flip null predicts the relative damage of random drop-and-rescale (DARE) at keep rate $p$ as $(1-p)/(p\,\rho_{\mathrm{sign}})$, within a factor of two of measurement wherever DARE succeeds. Two controls make these readings reliable: every controlled SFT and DPO trajectory with fp32 master weights loses leverage as it moves, and two re-runs of a released DPO stage from its anchor with its published recipe land within 1% of the released displacement and 4% of its leverage, where a plain recipe reads five to six times lower; leaving one component out traces the level to the length-normalized loss and its batch size of 128 together.
papers.title_ja: 重み更新がもたらすもの：学習段階間のレバレッジ
papers.summary_ja: 本研究では、重み変化の単位あたりの効果（レバレッジ）をフィッシャー情報量を用いて定量化する手法を提案し、事前学習・SFT・強化学習などの段階での挙動を比較した。事前学習はランダムな変化と同等のノイズに収束する一方、SFTやDPO、RLVRは大幅に高いレバレッジを示すことが判明した。また、bf16での学習はfp32マスターコピーがない場合に座標の凍結を引き起こし、レバレッジを最大7倍低下させることを示した。さらに、DARE（Drop-and-Rescale）の性能劣化を予測する法則を導出し、実測値と一致することを検証した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMの学習効率化・推論特性の理解に直結する手法

papers.title: ThinkJev: One Thought, Every Budget for Calibrated Typed Decisions
papers.summary: Many uses of language models end in a typed decision: a choice among a closed set of options, whose probabilities code can act on. Reading those probabilities from one forward pass is fast but often wrong on decisions that take several steps, such as arithmetic, counting, and date comparison. Letting the model think first fixes most of these errors, but costs seconds per decision instead of milliseconds. To pay for thinking only where it helps, ThinkJev builds a fast and a slow system from one open hybrid-thinking model that can answer directly or after a thought. System 1 reads the model's probabilities for the option letters when it answers directly; System 2 reads the same letters after the model has thought on the same cached prompt, so escalating repeats no work and both systems give probabilities over the same options. Because the letters can be read after any number of thought tokens, one sampled thought also gives the answer under every thinking budget. Without training, ThinkJev lets System 1 answer alone only where a statistical test on labeled dev data guarantees that its accepted answers stay under a target error rate. At a 5% target, Qwen3.5-27B answers 24.5% of 8359 test decisions this way with a realized error of 3.9% (Qwen3.5-4B and 9B: 6.5% and 0.0%). For the rest, stopping each thought as soon as its answer is confident reaches 81.6% accuracy, against 82.7% for always thinking, with 72% of the thought tokens. Choosing when to think from System 1's confidence alone saves less, because the decisions System 1 is least sure of are often not the ones thinking fixes. On the public items of JevBench, an independent benchmark of typed-decision services, Qwen3.5-27B thinks on 29.4% and is not distinguishable in accuracy from the two thinking APIs listed (exploratory). Code and data generators are available at https://github.com/ding-xiaolu/ThinkJev.
papers.title_ja: ThinkJev: 1つの思考で、あらゆる予算に対応する較正された型付き決定
papers.summary_ja: LLMによる型付き決定（選択肢からの選択）において、高速な直接回答（System 1）と思考を伴う回答（System 2）を1つのモデルから統合的に扱うフレームワークを提案する。統計的検定を用いて、System 1の誤答率が目標値以下であることを保証できる場合のみ直接回答し、それ以外は思考トークンを生成して精度を向上させる。これにより、常に思考させる場合と同等の精度を維持しつつ、思考トークン数を72%削減できることを示した。JevBenchなどのベンチマークで、既存の思考APIと比較して精度に差がないことを確認している。
papers.relevance_reason: LLM推論の効率化・コスト削減と評価手法に直結する

papers.title: OpenFrontiers: A Collection of Open Research Problems and a Benchmark for Scientific Rediscovery
papers.summary: Large language models (LLMs) have shown increasing promise in research-level problem solving, yet a comprehensive collection of such problems is still missing, and evaluating them on research-level problems remains challenging. We introduce OpenFrontiers, a cross-disciplinary resource that combines a structured corpus of open research problems with a retrospective benchmark of recently resolved problems in mathematics. The corpus records problem statements, context, progress, and other information for 12,151 problems. The benchmark contains 200 problems, 110 resolved in 2026 and 90 still open, each with a Lean~4 statement checked by automated probes and two independent reviews; a subset HQ-50 further filters based on quality score, etc. Our evaluation protocol grades formal proofs with two independent checkers in an isolated sandbox under closed-book, frozen-retrieval, and live-web conditions. Evaluating seven LLM agents on the HQ-50 subset under a standardized budget, we find that closed-book rediscovery is rare, at most 7 of 40 resolved problems, whereas live-web success mostly reflects retrieval of published solutions. By linking a broad research-problem corpus to a formally graded evaluation subset with documented solutions, OpenFrontiers provides a foundation for measuring research-level rediscovery and studying progress toward solving currently open scientific problems. The dataset and benchmark could be found in https://huggingface.co/collections/FlippyDora/openfrontiers.
papers.title_ja: OpenFrontiers: 未解決研究問題のコレクションと科学的再発見のためのベンチマーク
papers.summary_ja: LLMによる研究レベルの問題解決能力を評価するため、12,000件以上の未解決問題を含むコーパスと、Lean 4で形式化された200件の問題からなるベンチマーク「OpenFrontiers」を提案する。評価プロトコルでは、クローズドブック、凍結検索、ライブウェブの3条件下で、独立した2つのチェッカーを用いて証明の正しさを厳密に検証する。7つのLLMエージェントによる評価では、クローズドブックでの再発見は稀である一方、ライブウェブ環境での成功は既存解の検索に依存していることが示された。本リソースは、LLMの科学的発見能力の測定と、未解決問題へのアプローチ研究の基盤となる。
papers.relevance_reason: LLM評価・ベンチマーク設計とRAG/エージェント性能評価に直結する

papers.title: Improving Data-Constrained Scaling with Hyperparameter Transfer and Ensembling
papers.summary: As growing compute budgets outpace the growth of high-quality training data, large language models must be trained with both compute and data constraints in mind. Unfortunately, existing prescriptions for data-constrained scaling suffer from two important limitations. First, past works hold key hyperparameters such as weight decay fixed with scale, despite the fact that optimal hyperparameters vary wildly with model size and number of epochs. Second, past works neglect ensembling, a promising axis for scaling under data constraints. As a surprising consequence, prior prescriptions can lead to loss that increases with compute budget. We address both limitations by fitting power laws that prescribe how to transfer hyperparameters with scale and scaling laws that prescribe how to allocate compute with ensembling. Training on 100M tokens from FineWeb, our recipe reduces validation loss by over 0.15 nats compared to prior recipes, a 14% decrease in perplexity, and achieves monotonic improvements with compute through ensembling. These gains are achieved using prescriptions fit to smaller runs and validated at up to 12$\times$ larger compute budgets.
papers.title_ja: ハイパーパラメータ転移とアンサンブルによるデータ制約下スケーリングの改善
papers.summary_ja: 高品質な学習データが計算予算の増加に追いつかない状況において、LLMのデータ制約下スケーリング手法の限界を指摘する。既存手法がハイパーパラメータの固定やアンサンブルの無視により、計算量増加時に損失が増加する問題を抱えていることを示す。モデルサイズやエポック数に応じたハイパーパラメータの転移則と、アンサンブルへの計算資源配分則をパワーローで導出する。FineWebの1億トークンでの訓練により、既存手法比で検証損失を0.15ナツ以上低減し、計算量増加に伴う単調な性能向上を実現した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMの効率化・スケーリング則・推論コスト削減に直結する手法

papers.title: Muon Makes the First Mixture-of-Experts Layer Harder to Balance
papers.summary: Many open mixture-of-experts (MoE) language models train with Muon instead of AdamW. Most balance the load with a bias on each expert's routing score, adjusted after every step. Their recipes disagree on whether Muon should also train the router. In models with 55M and 108M active parameters, we measure how the optimizer changes the span of these biases, the largest minus the smallest in a layer. The span grows when all tokens favor the same experts, so it shows how hard a layer is to balance. At learning rates tuned on shorter runs, Muon raised the span of the first MoE layer at every seed, roughly doubling it on average, while the other layers changed much less. The rise came from Muon on the rest of the network, whichever optimizer trained the router. In those runs, the inputs to the first router shared a direction, and soon after the warmup its busiest expert averaged four to seven times its fair share. Over the first 3,000 steps, subtracting the batch mean from these inputs removed this overload while barely changing the loss. On the smaller model, halving Muon's learning rate removed most of the rise and slightly improved the loss. Moving only the router to AdamW made the loads shift more during the warmup and slightly raised the loss, so at this scale the results favor keeping the router on Muon.
papers.title_ja: Muon が最初の Mixture-of-Experts 層のバランス調整を困難にする
papers.summary_ja: MoE 言語モデルにおいて、Muon オプティマイザが最初の MoE 層のロードバランスを悪化させることを示した。学習率を調整した条件下で、Muon は他の層よりも最初の層のバイアス範囲を約 2 倍に拡大し、特定のエキスパートへの過剰な負荷を招いた。この現象はネットワーク全体の Muon 使用に起因し、入力からバッチ平均を引くことで負荷を軽減しつつ損失をほぼ維持できることが確認された。小規模モデルでは Muon の学習率を半減することで改善が見られ、ルーターを AdamW に切り替えるよりも Muon を維持する方が有利であることが示唆された。
papers.relevance_reason: LLM の MoE 構造とオプティマイザ選択に関する実用的な知見

papers.title: GARDEN: Generalist Autonomous Reward Design Through Evidence Navigation for Cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
papers.summary: Cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) enables teams of agents, such as robots and autonomous vehicles, to learn coordinated behavior, but what such teams learn is largely determined by their reward function. Because task success alone provides too little guidance for learning, intermediate rewards are usually designed by hand, and this effort must often be repeated whenever the environment or the team changes. Large language models (LLMs) can automate the effort by writing reward functions as code, yet the resulting rewards are typically designed and tested in a single setting. To enable their reuse across settings, GARDEN (Generalist Autonomous Reward Design through Evidence Navigation) is proposed, in which one reward program is developed for a family of related scenarios and transferred, unchanged, to scenarios that were not available during its design. During development, environment code, training records, and agent behavior are investigated by an LLM reward engineer, and draft rewards are tested in trial training runs, while the learning algorithm and the rule for selecting the final reward are held fixed. On unseen scenarios of the Overcooked and SMAX benchmarks, task returns were increased by 58.2% and 52.5% over the default rewards on two kitchen layouts, and the mean win rate in two combat scenarios was raised from 51.0% to 89.9%. Under matched candidate and probe budgets, this exceeded the 84.2% and 79.2% obtained with fixed diagnostic feedback and Eureka-inspired reward reflection. These results show that a single autonomously engineered reward can be reused effectively across related cooperative scenarios.
papers.title_ja: GARDEN: 協調型マルチエージェント強化学習のための証拠ナビゲーションによる汎用自律報酬設計
papers.summary_ja: 協調型マルチエージェント強化学習（MARL）において、LLMを用いて報酬関数を自動生成する手法GARDENを提案する。環境コードや学習記録をLLMが分析し、試行錯誤を通じて報酬プログラムを設計することで、設計時に使用しなかった未知のシナリオへもそのまま転移可能にする。OvercookedやSMAXなどのベンチマークにおいて、既存手法より大幅に高いタスクリターンと勝率を達成し、報酬設計の汎用性と効率性を示した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMと強化学習の組み合わせであり、ユーザーの関心領域に合致する

papers.title: Understanding Large Language Models as Numerical Optimizers
papers.summary: Large language models (LLMs) have emerged as potential tools for numerical optimization. Despite promising results, their intrinsic optimization capabilities and limitations remain poorly understood, particularly in high dimensions. This paper investigates the ability of LLMs to exploit mathematical problem structures and generate feasible, near-optimal solutions. We develop an evaluation framework that distinguishes solution quality from execution failures, including numerical inaccuracies, constraint violations, and output-format errors. Using representative problems from convex optimization, fractional programming, and constrained projection, we assess LLM performance against deterministic reference solvers across different dimensions. Our results reveal that LLMs can capture useful optimization structures and produce near-optimal solutions, even when their outputs fail to satisfy numerical or formatting requirements. However, reliability deteriorates with increasing problem dimension and depends strongly on the underlying optimization structure. To further investigate the limitations, we deploy an iterative refinement mechanism that provides targeted feedback on feasibility and solution quality. The results demonstrate that iterative refinement substantially improves reliability and extends the range of problem dimensions over which LLMs produce valid solutions. Nevertheless, persistent numerical and structural errors limit their applicability as standalone optimizers. These findings provide insights into the capacity and limits of LLM-based optimization and motivate hybrid approaches that combine LLM reasoning with deterministic numerical verification.
papers.title_ja: 数値最適化器としての大規模言語モデルの理解
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、大規模言語モデル（LLM）が数値最適化問題において数学的構造を活用し、実行可能な近似的最適解を生成できる能力を評価する。凸最適化や分数計画法などの代表的な問題を対象に、決定論的な参照ソルバと比較し、解の質と実行失敗（数値誤差や制約違反）を区別する評価フレームワークを構築した。結果として、LLMは低次元では有用な構造を捉えられるが、次元が増加するにつれて信頼性が低下し、反復的な改善メカニズムにより信頼性が向上することが示された。しかし、持続的な数値的・構造的エラーにより単独の最適化器としての適用には限界があり、LLMの推論と決定論的な数値検証を組み合わせるハイブリッド手法が有効であることが示唆される。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMの最適化能力評価とハイブリッド手法が関心に直結

papers.title: Preserving Safety During Sequential Fine-Tuning: A Factorial and Geometric Analysis of Replay
papers.summary: Benign fine-tuning can erode safety alignment in large language models, and sequential adaptation substantially compounds this risk. Prior work mitigates this erosion by replaying harmful-prompt refusals and benign-compliance examples, while other work instead matches base-model logits via distillation. However, the individual contributions of supervised exposure and distillation to safety behavior and refusal geometry during sequential adaptation remain unclear. We factor these two strategies apart and study their behavioral and geometric effects during sequential LoRA fine-tuning of Mistral-7B and Llama-3-8B across diverse task sequences (code generation, German-language summarization, and science question-answering). Behaviorally, supervised replay exposure yields the largest reduction in HarmBench attack success rate (ASR) on Mistral, averaging 51.1 points below base, but at a substantial over-refusal cost, averaging 53.4 points above base on OR-Bench-hard. Logit distillation, without any supervised replay loss, largely prevents safety erosion at a fraction of this cost: an average 5.4-point ASR reduction against only a 5.1-point rise in over-refusal. Llama shows the same asymmetry between the two strategies. Combining exposure and distillation moderates exposure's over-refusal while leaving downstream task scores largely unaffected. Geometrically, the two models diverge: on Mistral, distillation preserves the base refusal direction more closely than exposure does, whereas on Llama, refusal behavior after exposure largely survives ablation of the extracted refusal direction. This dissociation between models indicates that preserving the base refusal direction is not a reliable proxy for behavioral safety.
papers.title_ja: 逐次ファインチューニング時の安全性維持：リプレイの階層分析と幾何学的分析
papers.summary_ja: 大規模言語モデル（LLM）の逐次適応における安全性劣化を抑制するため、監督学習によるリプレイとロジット蒸留の効果を分離して分析した。Mistral-7BとLlama-3-8Bを用いた実験では、リプレイは攻撃成功率を大幅に低下させるが過剰拒否を招き、蒸留は低コストで安全性を維持することが示された。また、モデル間で拒否方向の幾何学的構造と行動的安全性の関連性が異なることが判明し、単なる方向保持では安全性を保証できないことを指摘している。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMのファインチューニング効率化と安全性評価に直結する手法

papers.title: Moment-Guided Optimizers for Noisy Deep Learning: MGO-SC as a Simple Consistency Gate for Adam-Style Updates
papers.summary: Adaptive optimizers are widely used in deep learning, yet their behavior can degrade under heavy stochasticity and label noise where the sign and magnitude of gradients can be unstable. We study MGO-SC (Moment-Guided Optimizer with Sign-Consistency), a lightweight modification of Adam-style methods that derives a coordinate-wise consistency gate from the magnitude of a sign exponential moving average (EMA): coordinates whose gradient sign is stable are trusted, while coordinates whose sign fluctuates are down-weighted. We show that the naive form of this gate, which can only shrink updates, loses effective step size and underperforms when the learning rate is matched to the baseline. We therefore introduce a mean-preserving variant that reallocates trust across coordinates without changing the net per-tensor step magnitude. On CIFAR-10 with ResNet-18, under a matched learning rate and decoupled weight decay, mean-preserving MGO-SC consistently improves over its AdamW baseline across clean, symmetric, and asymmetric label noise (e.g., +1.4 points at 40% symmetric noise; paired bootstrap 95% CI excluding zero; Wilcoxon p<0.01), while adding no second-order information or per-sample filtering. We report matched-seed effect sizes, nonparametric bootstrap confidence intervals, and paired significance tests, and we release code and raw logs.
papers.title_ja: ノイジー深層学習のためのモーメント誘導型オプティマイザ：Adam風更新における簡易な一貫性ゲートとしてのMGO-SC
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、ラベルノイズや高確率性下で勾配の符号が不安定になる問題に対し、Adam系オプティマイザに軽量な修正を加えたMGO-SCを提案する。勾配符号の指数移動平均（EMA）の大きさから座標ごとの一貫性ゲートを導出し、符号が安定した座標のみを信頼して更新を行う。単純なゲートはステップサイズを縮小するため、テンソル全体のステップ大きさを保ちつつ信頼度を再配分する平均保存型バリアントを導入した。CIFAR-10での実験により、対称・非対称ノイズ下でAdamWベースラインを上回る性能（例：40%ノイズで+1.4ポイント）と統計的有意性を示した。
papers.relevance_reason: 深層学習の最適化手法であり、ノイズ耐性という実務的な課題を解決する手法として関連性が高い。

papers.title: LRMoE: Demand-Side Load Re-Calibration for Efficient MoE Training on Memory-Constrained Nodes
papers.summary: Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models offer scalable capacity for Web applications, but uneven routing creates computation and communication bottlenecks. Existing placement and replication methods redistribute this workload, yet additional expert copies compete with token-related buffers for limited GPU memory. We present LRMoE, a memory-aware MoE training system that jointly recalibrates backward demand and balances the retained workload. During forward execution, it plans retention quotas and expert placement under resource constraints while preserving all routed computations. During backpropagation, a load recalibration metric estimates each token-expert pair's contribution to the expert update and selects pairs within these quotas. A capacity-aware routing algorithm distributes retained pairs among eligible instances of their original experts. Physical compaction then forms smaller communication payloads and variable-size grouped GEMMs, reducing backward traffic, computation, and execution-buffer demand. Experiments on Qwen3-30B-A3B and GLM4.5-106B-A12B show that LRMoE reduces cumulative MoE-layer training time to fixed-loss targets by 21.2-44.8% relative to SYMI.
papers.title_ja: LRMoE: メモリ制約ノードにおける効率的なMoE学習のための需要側ロード再較正
papers.summary_ja: Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) モデルの学習において、ルーティングの不均衡が引き起こす計算・通信ボトルネックとGPUメモリ不足を解決するシステムを提案する。本手法は、フォワードパスでリテンションクォータとエキスパート配置を計画し、バックプロパゲーションではトークンとエキスパートのペアの寄与度を評価して選択することで、メモリ使用量と通信量を最適化する。Qwen3-30B-A3BやGLM4.5-106B-A12Bでの実験により、既存手法SYMIと比較して21.2〜44.8%の学習時間短縮効果が示された。

papers.title: Threshold Compatibility and Support-Selection Diagnostics in Neural Discovery of Partial Differential Equations
papers.summary: Accurate regression need not yield the correct equation after support selection. For a median/sample-standard-deviation threshold in neural PDE discovery, we derive an exact two-signal retention boundary and a complete-vector perturbation bound. Exact advection-diffusion libraries lose diffusion despite coefficient recovery to numerical precision. True-support refits of forty saved sparse states reduce diffusion error without restoring all derivative accuracy. A fixed sequential threshold ridge comparator recovers exact support in sixty ideal controls but selects extra terms in every learned state. All-fold correct-support candidates are rejected by conditional validation; post hoc energy pooling preserves their higher minimum loss in all sixty states. Supplied-support estimates outperform unchanged selected equations in all 240 physical-residual comparisons on four unused analytic trajectories. With coefficients, observation points and weights fixed, exact replacement of the learned library and target reverses their learned-row ordering in 59/60 states. Weighting both losses also fails the specified Burgers diffusion-benefit criterion at every tested budget. These finite diagnostics distinguish threshold incompatibility, refit damage and score rejection; they establish neither automatic correction nor general recovery or predictive stability.
papers.title_ja: 神経PDE発見における閾値互換性とサポート選択の診断
papers.summary_ja: ニューラルネットワークを用いた偏微分方程式（PDE）の自動発見において、回帰精度が高くてもサポート選択（項の選択）が誤る現象を分析した。中央値と標準偏差に基づく閾値処理では、拡散項が正しく復元されない「閾値互換性の欠如」や、再学習による誤差増大、検証段階での候補棄却などの問題が特定された。これらの有限診断は、機械学習による物理法則発見における評価手法の限界と、単純な閾値設定がもたらす構造的な失敗モードを明確に示している。

papers.title: Amortized Localized Posterior Inference for Model Calibration with Application to an Ocean Turbulence Closure
papers.summary: Model discrepancy may prevent a single calibration parameter from reproducing a physical response across the context domain. In addition, uncertainties in observations and contexts affect calibration and must be accounted for and quantified. We construct a family of localized posteriors by weighting observation likelihoods according to their proximity to a target context. Gaussian localization weights incorporate context uncertainty through covariance inflation, with reflection at domain boundaries and an optional correction for uneven context sampling. A conditional normalizing flow approximates the family of posteriors through amortized variational inference. Integrating the localized posteriors under a prescribed context measure gives the marginalized parameter distribution. In a twin experiment with the Branin-Hoo model, we compare global and localized inference under uniform and skewed context distributions. Localization reduces the reported aggregate predictive errors relative to the global posterior. An application to the k-$\epsilon$ turbulence closure in a single-column ocean model, with atmospheric surface forcing as context, shows that localized posterior calibration reduces temperature and zonal-velocity errors relative to deterministic and global-posterior calibration. Both twin experiments are constructed to admit local compensation.
papers.title_ja: 海洋乱流閉鎖への応用を伴うモデル較正のための償却型局所化事後推論
papers.summary_ja: 観測の文脈依存性を考慮し、重み付けによって局所化された事後分布の族を構築する手法を提案する。条件付き正規化フローを用いた償却型変分推論により、この分布族を効率的に近似し、文脈分布下での周辺化パラメータ分布を得る。Branin-Hooモデルを用いた双子実験では、局所化推論がグローバル推論より予測誤差を低減することを示した。さらに、単一カラム海洋モデルのk-ε乱流閉鎖への適用により、決定論的較正やグローバル事後較正と比較して温度・東西風速の誤差が減少することを検証した。

papers.title: Echo: Scaling Visual Reinforcement Learning with Off-policy Experience
papers.summary: Scaling visual reinforcement learning (RL) with GPU-accelerated simulation is computationally expensive due to rendering and visual-policy inference costs. Consequently, two-stage teacher--student distillation is commonly used to train visual policies, but introduces an imitation gap. In this preliminary study, we introduce \echomethod{}, \textbf{a single-stage off-policy RL framework that scales experience collection without proportionally increasing visual computation}. Through \textbf{inverse distillation}, a state-based auxiliary policy imitates the evolving visual policy and collects inexpensive, unrendered experience. Echo leverages this experience for off-policy value learning, directly improving the visual policy through a shared privileged critic. We instantiate \echomethod{} with FastTD3 and evaluate it on three visual control tasks and two dexterous manipulation tasks in Genesis. Relative to \sdpgmethod{} under the evaluated configurations, Echo reduces time to reference returns by an average of \textbf{60\% across the three locomotion tasks} and \textbf{56\% across both hand tasks}, while improving peak mean returns by \textbf{62\% and 12\%}, respectively. Both hand tasks also achieve higher mean returns at matched simulator-transition budgets. These initial results suggest that scaling off-policy experience is a promising approach to efficient direct visual RL.
papers.title_ja: Echo: オフポリシー経験を用いた視覚強化学習のスケーリング
papers.summary_ja: GPUシミュレーションにおけるレンダリングコストを削減するため、単一ステージのオフポリシー強化学習フレームワーク「Echo」を提案する。逆蒸留により状態ベースの補助ポリシーが視覚ポリシーを模倣し、低コストな未レンダリング経験を収集する。この経験を用いたオフポリシー価値学習により、視覚ポリシーを直接改善する。Genesis環境での評価において、参照リターン達成時間を平均60%短縮し、ピークレターンを向上させることを示した。
papers.relevance_reason: 強化学習の効率化と推論コスト削減がユーザー関心と一致

papers.title: Benchmarking Quantum Neural Networks Developed for MBHB Coalescence in the Context of LISA Space Mission
papers.summary: Machine learning (ML) techniques are increasingly explored to analyse gravitational wave (GW) data expected from the Laser Interferometer Space Antenna (LISA). At the same time, advances in quantum computing have stimulated interest in quantum machine learning as a potential alternative to conventional approaches. We investigate the applicability of quantum, hybrid quantum-classical, and classical ML models to two tasks relevant for LISA observations of massive black hole binaries: GW signal detection and merger prediction. Using the Sangria dataset from the LISA Data Challenge, we benchmark several quantum architectures, including variational quantum classifiers (VQCs), post VQC hybrid models, quantum kernel methods, data reuploading classifiers, and quantum long short-term memory (QLSTM) networks, against classical support vector machines, multilayer perceptrons, recurrent neural networks, and LSTM networks. The models are trained on labelled data derived from the Sangria training dataset and evaluated on the corresponding blind dataset. For signal detection, several quantum models match or outperform classical baselines. In particular, the best performing hybrid post VQC architecture correctly identifies all signal samples in the blind dataset, while the standard VQC and data reuploading classifier achieve competitive detection rates. For merger detection and coalescence time estimation, however, the standard VQC emerges as the most reliable model, successfully localising all detected merger events with the lowest localisation errors. We further analyse the trade-offs between predictive performance, model complexity, and quantum circuit resources. Our results indicate that, although no universal quantum advantage is observed, selected quantum models can provide practical benefits for specific GW analysis tasks and represent promising candidates for future LISA data analysis pipelines.
papers.title_ja: LISA宇宙ミッションにおけるMBHB合体に向けた量子ニューラルネットワークのベンチマーク
papers.summary_ja: LISAミッションで観測される大質量ブラックホール二重星の重力波データ解析において、量子機械学習モデルの適用可能性を評価した。Sangriaデータセットを用い、変分量子分類器や量子LSTMなどの量子・ハイブリッドモデルを、古典的なSVMやRNNと比較した。信号検出ではハイブリッドモデルが優れる一方、合体時刻推定では標準的なVQCが最も信頼性が高い結果となった。普遍的な量子優位性は見られなかったが、特定のタスクで実用的な利点があり、将来のLISAデータ解析パイプラインへの統合が有望と結論づけている。

papers.title: Preparation of a celestial field for precise VLBI observations of the JUICE spacecraft: a test case of the Venus flyby
papers.summary: The Jupiter Icy Moons Explorer mission, launched in 2023, is on its way to the Jovian system, to arrive in 2031. The Planetary Radio Interferometry and Doppler Experiment performs radio astronomical observations of the spacecraft already in its interplanetary cruise phase. Since the sky density of potential compact radio sources suitable as phase-reference calibrators in very long baseline interferometry observations is low, densifying the celestial reference frame along the Ecliptic is an essential task in support of JUICE. In preparation for the JUICE gravity assist manoeuvre at Venus in August 2025, to support the accurate reconstruction of the spacecraft state vector, we selected in-beam calibrator source candidates along the JUICE trajectory. Additionally, we attempted to link known nearby bright compact reference sources from the Radio Fundamental Catalog to the International Celestial Reference Frame. We performed nodding-style phase-referencing VLBI observations with the European VLBI Network at 8.4GHz, targeting nine in-beam calibrator candidate and three RFC sources in the celestial vicinity of JUICE's trajectory during its Venus flyby. We linked their positions to nearby ICRF sources by means of relative astrometry. Four of the ICC targets and all RFC sources were detected and imaged with the EVN, and their coordinates determined with typically sub-mas precision. Although none of the targeted ICC sources proved suitable as VLBI phase-reference calibrators because of being too faint or resolved, their newly-determined positions and flux densities could in principle be used to verify the detection of the spacecraft at the time of the actual flyby around Venus. During the detailed analysis of the ICC targets, we found that the structure of one of them, J0843+1826 is resolved on mas scale, and the other one, J0843+1814 is a young radio galaxy, likely a member of a cluster.
papers.title_ja: JUICE宇宙船の精密VLBI観測のための天域準備：金星フライバイのテストケース
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、木星氷衛星探査機JUICEの金星フライバイ前後におけるVLBI観測支援を目的とした研究である。低密度な電波源の天域を高密度化するため、軌道上のキャリブレータ候補を選定し、欧州VLBIネットワーク（EVN）を用いて相対天文学的手法で位置を決定した。結果として、4つの候補源と既知の基準源の座標をサブミリ秒角精度で特定し、宇宙船状態ベクトルの正確な再構築に貢献できる可能性を示した。また、一部の候補源が分解能限界を超えていたことや、若い電波銀河であることが判明した。

papers.title: Jailbreak Connectivity: Towards Diverse, Transferable, and Universal Multimodal Large Language Model Jailbreak
papers.summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are vulnerable to visual jailbreak attacks that bypass safety safeguards. Existing methods typically optimize isolated adversarial examples, limiting attack diversity, transferability, and generalization. We propose Jailbreak Connectivity (JC), a framework based on the observation that effective adversarial inputs can be connected through low-loss regions in image space. JC optimizes continuous adversarial paths: path sampling yields diverse jailbreak images, lightweight surrogate classifiers guide cross-model transfer, and a distribution-level objective enables universal attacks across harmful queries. On MM-SafetyBench, JC achieves average attack success rates of 84.01%, 85.77%, and 97.95% on Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct, InternVL3.5-8B, and Gemma-3-12B-IT, respectively, exceeding the strongest baselines by up to 68.36 percentage points. In black-box evaluations, JC improves attack success rates over FigStep by 24.69 and 27.34 percentage points on GPT-5.6 and Gemini 3.1 Pro, respectively. These findings reveal structured vulnerabilities in MLLM safety alignment and inform more comprehensive security evaluation.
papers.title_ja: ジェイルブレイク接続性：多様で、転移可能かつ普遍的なマルチモーダル大規模言語モデルのジェイルブレイクへ
papers.summary_ja: マルチモーダル大規模言語モデル（MLLM）に対する視覚的ジェイルブレイク攻撃の多様性・転移性・汎化性を高めるフレームワーク「Jailbreak Connectivity (JC)」を提案する。画像空間における低損失領域を連続的な敵対的パスとして最適化し、サロゲート分類器を用いてクロスモデル転移を導く手法を採用した。MM-SafetyBenchにおいて既存ベースラインを大幅に上回る攻撃成功率を達成し、ブラックボックス環境でも高い有効性を示した。本研究はMLLMの安全性アライメントにおける構造的脆弱性を明らかにし、より包括的なセキュリティ評価に貢献する。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMの安全性評価とサロゲートモデル利用が関心に該当

papers.title: A Gradient based Adversarial Augmentation Framework for Mitigating Unlearnable Datasets
papers.summary: Unlearnable data methods (ULD) protect public data from unauthorized model training by adding imperceptible perturbations that create a learning shortcut. A deep neural network can exploit the shortcut learning path to minimize training loss without learning generalizable features. Intuitively, finding adversarial versions of perturbed images that can substantially increase the model's loss can force the model to learn generalizable features. Existing data augmentation based attacks rely on heuristic search strategies/random sampling over a curated augmentation set to identify adversarial augmentation operations, an approach that often does not scale when the number of candidate operations is large. To address the challenge of a large search space, we propose {\techname}, a gradient based adversarial augmentation framework that learns an augmentation policy via stochastic gradient ascent. {\techname} leverages a differentiable data augmentation pipeline to efficiently search a set of up to 18 augmentation techniques, from which a grid search selects a protection-specific subset. The augmentation subset is trained to maximize a surrogate model's classification loss. We introduce a perceptual-plus-pixel regularization to learn operation parameters that preserve image semantics. Under a controlled ablation, {\techname} consistently outperforms an equivalent random sampling baseline (80.0\% vs. 77.29\% clean test accuracy on EMIN-protected CIFAR-10 for ResNet-18 and 83.28\% vs. 66.45\% on NTGA-protected CIFAR-10 for MobileNet-V2), demonstrating that gradient guidance drives the clean test accuracy recoverability rather than the expanded search space. {\techname} offers an effective and scalable adversarial augmentation framework for stress-testing ULD methods, a critical tool for developing robust ULD methods.
papers.title_ja: 学習不能データセットの緩和に向けた勾配ベースの敵対的拡張フレームワーク
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、公開データセットの不正利用を防ぐ「学習不能データ（ULD）」手法に対する攻撃手法を提案する。既存のランダムサンプリングやヒューリスティックな探索では大規模な拡張操作空間を効率的に扱えない問題を解決するため、微分可能なデータ拡張パイプラインを用いた勾配ベースの敵対的拡張フレームワークを開発した。サロゲートモデルの損失を最大化するように拡張ポリシーを学習し、画像の意味を保持する正則化を導入することで、モデルが汎化可能な特徴を学習するよう強制する。実験により、ランダムサンプリングベースラインと比較してクリーンテスト精度の回復率が大幅に向上することが示され、ULD手法の頑健性を評価するための有効なツールとして機能することが確認された。

papers.title: UnEZ: A Fully Unsupervised Self-Templating Neural Network for Redshift and Line Strength Estimation
papers.summary: As spectroscopic surveys grow, estimating galaxy properties such as metallicity, star formation rate, and redshift becomes computationally cumbersome. Methods of estimating such properties rely on template spectra or curated redshift catalogs, which fail to represent the diversity of objects seen in large-scale surveys. We present UnEZ, a fully unsupervised, physics-informed machine learning model that can predict spectroscopic redshifts and line strengths with no prior redshift or line strength labels. An encoder predicts emission and absorption line amplitudes/widths, and a fixed deterministic decoder constructs a unique template, estimated redshift, redshift confidence curve, and spectral model. UnEZ was tested on the Sloan Digital Sky Survey (SDSS) Data Release 18 due to its large dataset and thoroughly vetted redshift catalog which serves as an independent benchmark. Despite the lack of templates, line strength labels, or redshift labels, UnEZ's performance competes with modern redshift estimation algorithms. At SNR > 10, UnEZ achieves an outlier fraction of 0.459% and a normalized median absolute deviation (NMAD) of $1.237 \times 10^{-4}$. At SNR > 3, UnEZ achieves an outlier fraction of 3.89% and an NMAD of $1.471 \times 10^{-4}$. Furthermore, we demonstrate how UnEZ's line strength and redshift predictions can be utilized for various purposes such as constructing template spectra required in traditional redshift estimation algorithms. UnEZ illustrates how a fully unsupervised neural network can allow redshift, among other galaxy properties, to emerge naturally from the spectra themselves, providing a template-free, label-free approach that scales to the demands of future surveys.
papers.title_ja: UnEZ: 赤方偏移と線強度の推定のための完全教師なしセルフテンプレートニューラルネットワーク
papers.summary_ja: 大規模分光サーベイにおける銀河の赤方偏移や線強度の推定を、テンプレートやラベルなしで実現する完全教師なしの物理情報機械学習モデル「UnEZ」を提案する。エンコーダがスペクトルから発光・吸収線の振幅や幅を予測し、デコーダがテンプレートや赤方偏移を構築する。SDSSデータを用いた検証では、現代のアルゴリズムと競合する精度を示し、テンプレート不要でスケーラビリティが高いことを実証した。

papers.title: The Utility of Physics-Informed Machine Learning in Solar Power Production Forecasting
papers.summary: Physics-informed machine learning (PIML) and hybrid modeling have attracted significant attention as approaches for combining physical knowledge with the flexibility of deep learning. In this work, we investigate whether these approaches deliver their commonly claimed benefits for large-scale photovoltaic (PV) power forecasting. We develop two hybrid forecasting architectures that integrate the ADR physical PV efficiency model with the TSMixer neural forecasting architecture through feature augmentation and residual learning. The proposed models are evaluated on a dataset comprising over 3 million samples from 3,713 PV installations across 33 European countries. We assess convergence speed, forecasting accuracy, transferability across geographical regions, and data efficiency. Although the physics-informed models seem to exhibit slightly faster convergence during training, they do not achieve consistent improvements in test-set accuracy, generalization, or performance under limited training data compared to the purely data-driven baseline. These findings suggest that, for modern deep forecasting architectures trained on large datasets, explicitly incorporating the ADR physical model provides limited practical benefit for day-ahead PV forecasting.
papers.title_ja: 太陽光発電予測における物理情報機械学習の有用性
papers.summary_ja: 物理情報機械学習（PIML）とハイブリッドモデリングが太陽光発電予測において期待される利点を果たすかを検証した。ADR物理モデルとTSMixerを統合した2つのハイブリッド予測アーキテクチャを提案し、欧州33カ国の3713基のPV設備からなる大規模データセットで評価した。収束速度はわずかに向上したが、テストセット精度、汎化性能、データ効率において純粋なデータ駆動型ベースラインと比較して一貫した改善は見られなかった。大規模データセットで訓練される現代の深層予測アーキテクチャにおいて、明示的な物理モデルの統合は実務上の利点が限定的であることが示唆された。

papers.title: Multi-Solution Inverse Design of Pixelated Patch Antennas Using an Autoregressive Transformer
papers.summary: Deep-learning-based inverse design has emerged as a promising framework for pixelated patch antenna synthesis by enabling broader exploration of discrete geometry spaces and reducing design time compared with conventional template-based methods. Existing methods, including surrogate-assisted metaheuristic optimization, tandem inverse networks, and diffusion models, have advanced the field but still face practical limitations. Metaheuristic methods such as binary particle swarm optimization (BPSO) are sensitive to initialization and search hyperparameters and are often time-consuming, tandem networks have difficulty capturing the one-to-many nature of inverse antenna design, and diffusion models may require excessive complexity and data for moderate-scale binary layout synthesis. In this paper, an autoregressive (AR) transformer is presented for the inverse design of 10 x 10 pixelated patch antennas. Its sequential discrete generation process enables the synthesis of multiple feasible structures for a given target response. The pretrained model is further fine-tuned for dual-band design using step-shaped target responses with sharp spectral transitions, allowing intuitive band specification without manually constructing detailed S11 curves. Compared with BPSO, our proposed method generates valid and diverse antenna candidates more efficiently. Fabricated and measured examples confirm that distinct pixelated layouts can realize the desired antenna responses, thereby demonstrating the multi-solution capability of the proposed framework.
papers.title_ja: 自己回帰型Transformerを用いたピクセル化パッチアンテナの多解逆設計
papers.summary_ja: ピクセル化パッチアンテナの逆設計において、既存のメタヒューリスティック法や拡散モデルの限界を克服するため、自己回帰型Transformerを提案する。この手法は離散的な生成プロセスにより、特定の目標応答に対して多様な有効な構造を効率的に合成できる。さらに、ステップ状の目標応答を用いたファインチューニングにより、詳細なS11曲線の手動構築なしでデュアルバンド設計を可能にする。実測例を通じて、異なるピクセルレイアウトが所望のアンテナ応答を実現できることを示し、多解性および効率性を検証した。
papers.relevance_reason: 深層学習による逆設計手法だが、対象がアンテナであり軌道力学とは無関係

papers.title: Surface Conditioning for Zero-Shot Multivariate Correction in a Marine Biogeochemistry Emulator
papers.summary: Bias correction in process-based models usually means iterative data assimilation with explicit covariance modelling. We propose a lightweight alternative based on a neural emulator of marine biogeochemistry (BGC), showing that the conditioning pathway of its autoencoder can serve as an observation injection point. The decoder is conditioned on surface variables via Feature-wise Linear Modulation (FiLM), originally designed to incorporate physical boundary forcings. We extend these inputs to include surface chlorophyll-a and replace the simulated field with satellite observations at inference time. The surface substitution propagates through the water column, improving agreement with depth-resolved observations at all depths, and spreads to other output variables in a pattern consistent with expected trophic relationships.
papers.title_ja: 海洋生物地球化学エミュレータにおけるゼロショット多変数補正のための表面条件付け
papers.summary_ja: プロセスベースモデルのバイアス補正において、反復的なデータ同化に代わる軽量な手法を提案する。海洋生物地球化学のニューラルエミュレータ（オートエンコーダ）のデコーダに、物理的境界強制を取り込むためのFiLM（Feature-wise Linear Modulation）を用いる。推論時に表面クロロフィルaなどの衛星観測データを表面変数として入力し、これを水柱全体へ伝播させることで、深さ分解された観測値との一致度を改善する。この手法は、期待される栄養関係と整合するパターンで他の出力変数にも補正効果を波及させる。
papers.relevance_reason: 物理情報エミュレータと条件付け技術の活用は関心領域だが、海洋特化のため汎用性は低い

papers.title: IMPACT: Inverter-Informed Multimodal Learning for Photovoltaic Generation Forecasting
papers.summary: This work develops a physics-informed multimodal deep learning framework for 10- to 110-minute-ahead probabilistic photovoltaic power forecasting. The forecasting model is built on a four-branch architecture that separately encodes plant-level temporal history and inverter-level spatial cloud dynamics through a graph attention encoder with a learned adjacency, known-future solar geometry, and the current meteorological state, fused through gated cross-attention. The geometry branch adds two forward-looking physical signals, spatial cloud heterogeneity and inverter ramp-down activity, each empirically weighted toward the horizon where it is most predictive. The decoder anchors its prediction to a smart persistence baseline, learning a horizon-conditioned correction, and the resulting quantile forecasts are calibrated online through a kernel-weighted adaptive conformal calibration step. The proposed model outperforms all 14 baselines, achieving a forecast skill score (FSS) of 0.2950, 0.099 above the next-best model. A branch-composition ablation shows that every branch contributes positively and the model retains substantial skill in challenging overcast and variable sky conditions (FSS 0.198 and 0.255).
papers.title_ja: IMPACT: 太陽光発電予測のためのインバータ情報活用型マルチモーダル学習
papers.summary_ja: 太陽光発電の確率予測において、物理情報とマルチモーダル深層学習を統合したフレームワークを提案する。グラフアテンションエンコーダを用いてプラントレベルの時系列履歴とインバータレベルの空間的雲動態を個別にエンコードし、既知の未来太陽幾何学や気象状態と融合する。デコーダはスマートパーシステンスベースラインをアンカーとし、カーネル重み付き適応的コンフォーマルキャリブレーションにより予測の信頼区間をオンラインで調整する。14種のベースラインを上回り、特に曇天や変動天候下でも高い予測スキルを示した。
papers.relevance_reason: 物理情報深層学習と予測手法は関心領域だが、対象が軌道力学ではなく太陽光発電であるため。

papers.title: The Best Second Opinion Is Right Where the Primary Is Wrong: Partner Selection for Selective Span Tagging
papers.summary: A span tagger that ranks its outputs by risk can defer the riskiest ones to a person, and a second model can sharpen this ranking. Which second model should it be? Partner selection is conditional, not global: the best second opinion is the model that is right where the primary is wrong. Across eight tagger types, three seeds and three English benchmarks (576 evaluated primary-partner pairings), choosing the partner by held-out accuracy on the primary's errors recovers 82% of the best partner's gain, against 69-70% for span F1 or a random pick. Frozen before a fourth dataset was chosen, the rule replicated there (Spearman 0.40 vs. 0.04 for span F1). Partner value is also directional. The predictive distribution is the second opinion: hard labels discard half of a partner's value, and scoring the served label improves 94% of pairings. Fixed before the fourth dataset was chosen, this score also replicated there. For LoRA-tuned decoders, independently trained partners beat every readout of the primary network. Applied zero-shot to 51 MASSIVE locales, every primary has a helpful trained partner in every locale, and the preferred partner follows competence.
papers.title_ja: 最良の第二意見は一次モデルが誤る箇所に正解するもの：選択的スパンタグリングにおけるパートナー選択
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、リスクベースの選択的推論において、一次モデルの誤答箇所に対して正解率が高いモデルを「パートナー」として選択する手法を提案する。8種類のタグガーと3つのベンチマークを用いた実験により、一次モデルのエラーセットでの精度に基づいたパートナー選択が、従来のSpan F1やランダム選択よりも大幅に性能を向上させることを示した。さらに、ハードラベルではなく予測分布（ソフトラベル）を用いることでパートナーの価値を最大化し、LoRAチューニング済みモデルや多言語環境でも有効性を検証した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLM推論の信頼性向上と評価手法に関わるが、軌道力学やサロゲートモデルとは無関係

papers.title: One Confidence Threshold, Unequal Coverage: Language Gaps in Typed Decision Interfaces and How Translating Inputs Reduces Them
papers.summary: Deployed classifiers often act on a prediction only when its confidence clears a threshold and pass the rest to a person. We ask whether one threshold serves all languages equally on typed decision interfaces, APIs that return a probability for each option of a fixed multiple-choice question. In a confirmatory study with a written analysis plan, three vendors' interfaces classified 1,000 MASSIVE items, each in 51 languages, with a threshold of 0.9. Even when a request is answered correctly in both English and another language, the English version clears the threshold more often, by 8.6-11.7 percentage points on average. Observed coverage, the share of requests handled automatically, is lower than English's in every other language, while the requests the gate handles are rarely wrong. The gap remains when every language is reweighted to the same accuracy, and a standard calibration metric (ECE) does not detect it on one interface. In exploratory analyses, English's coverage stays higher when each language gets its own threshold fitted to the same 5% error target. Translating inputs into English nearly closes the gap at 0.9 but leaves English ahead at that error target. Requests written natively in African languages show a gap in the same direction when English is their human translation. We recommend reporting per-language coverage at the operating threshold.
papers.title_ja: 1つの信頼度閾値、不均等なカバレッジ：型付き決定インターフェースにおける言語ギャップと入力翻訳によるその縮小
papers.summary_ja: 分類器が信頼度閾値を超えた予測のみ自動処理する際、英語以外の言語では正解であっても閾値をクリアする頻度が低く、自動処理率（カバレッジ）が低下する現象を定量的に示した。51言語のデータを用いた検証により、このギャップは精度の再重み付けや標準的な較正指標（ECE）では検出されにくいことが判明した。入力テキストを英語に翻訳することでギャップは大幅に縮小するが、完全には解消しない。本研究は、運用閾値における言語別カバレッジの報告を推奨し、多言語環境でのAIシステムの公平性と効率化に関する重要な知見を提供している。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMの推論効率化や評価手法に関わるが、軌道力学やサロゲートモデルとは無関係

papers.title: Identifying Scientifically Interesting Galaxies with Vision-Language Models
papers.summary: Anomaly searches in large astronomical image datasets aim to identify rare objects for follow-up investigation. Yet the objects that are most statistically unusual are not necessarily those of greatest scientific relevance. We investigate whether pretrained vision-language models can directly assess scientific interest from natural-language instructions, enabling galaxy images to be ranked without labeled examples. We evaluate models on a 20,000-image Hubble Space Telescope sample that includes 167 reference anomalies previously identified through machine learning and expert inspection. By scoring images for scientific interest, Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite places 98.2% of the reference anomalies within the highest-ranked ~2,000 images, at a present-day inference cost of approximately $5.05 per 10,000 images. We recover known gravitational lenses, jellyfish-galaxy candidates, and galaxies with visible jets, and release 102 high-scoring candidates for further investigation. These results show that an off-the-shelf vision-language model, without any training on the target data, offers a practical way to rank large image datasets by scientific relevance rather than rarity. The project code is available at https://github.com/TheCheng2005/Galaxy-Anomaly-Search/
papers.title_ja: ビジョン・言語モデルを用いた科学的に興味深い銀河の特定
papers.summary_ja: 大規模な天文学画像データセットにおける異常検出において、統計的に珍しい物体が必ずしも科学的に重要であるとは限らない問題に対し、事前学習済みビジョン・言語モデル（VLM）の活用を提案する。ラベル付けされた例なしで自然言語指示に基づき銀河画像の科学的興味度を評価し、ハッブル宇宙望遠鏡の2万画像サンプルで検証した。Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite は、既存の機械学習や専門家による検査で特定された167の参照異常の98.2%を上位2,000画像以内にランク付けし、推論コストも低かった。既知の重力レンズやジェリーフィッシュ銀河候補などを復元し、新たな高得点候補102件を公開した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLM/VLMの効率的な推論と実務応用に関わるが、対象分野が天文学であり軌道力学とは無関係

papers.title: Spokes, not a Ring: Revisiting the Weekday Manifold in Language Models
papers.summary: Recent work has hypothesised that large language models may represent some concepts as multi-dimensional manifolds instead of single directions. Using these manifolds to interpret or steer representations often assumes that moving along them corresponds to a continuous change in the represented concept. In this work, we test this continuous manifold assumption on the prototypical weekday manifold. Despite its striking circular geometry, we find that the weekday representations behave more like seven discrete states arranged in a circle than a continuous ring. First, we show that local sensitivity has seven minima aligned with the weekdays, producing a step-like mapping between representation and behaviour under on-manifold steering. Second, we test whether any concepts are represented along the manifold outside the seven discrete states, and find neither time of day, uncertainty, nor natural text populate the intermediate space. Together, these results challenge the continuous interpretation of the weekday manifold and motivate testing whether movement along other representation manifolds correspond to meaningful changes in model representations and behaviour.
papers.title_ja: 輪ではなくスポーク：言語モデルにおける曜日マニホールドの再検討
papers.summary_ja: 大規模言語モデル（LLM）の内部表現において、曜日概念が連続的な円環状マニホールドとして存在するという仮説を検証した。本研究では、表現空間の局所感度解析により、7つの離散的な状態が円周上に配置されていることを示し、中間領域には意味のある概念（時刻や不確実性など）が存在しないことを明らかにした。この結果は、マニホールドに沿った連続的な操作がモデルの挙動を滑らかに変化させるという従来の解釈を否定し、表現空間の構造理解における離散性の重要性を指摘している。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMの内部表現解釈に関わるが、効率化やRAG等の実務手法とは距離があるため

papers.title: Predicate Neuron: Differentiable Quantization of Predicate Relations in Gradient-based Learning
papers.summary: In machine learning, symbolic reasoning approaches often rely on static architectures that hinder integration into deep neural networks and gradient-based optimization. To address this, we introduce the Native Predicate Neuron, a differentiable logic-reasoning neural module that enriches standard architectures with symbolic reasoning capabilities via first-order logic quantization. The proposed neuron models relational logic by learning to alternate between operations using a single trainable parameter. It features a tailored gradient mechanism with a dual-nature formulation: executing hard logical operations during training while maintaining differentiability for backpropagation. By quantizing both its input and choice state, the Predicate Neuron approximates continuous and non-continuous functions, effectively resolving discontinuities that standard deep learning architectures struggle with. We evaluate the Predicate Neuron across Fully-Connected, Convolutional, Recurrent, and Transformer architectures on benchmarks like MNIST and Wikitext. Results show that incorporating Predicate Neurons accelerates convergence, boosts accuracy, and lowers loss in general, with particularly strong improvements in tasks requiring monotonic reasoning or handling discontinuities. Overall, the Predicate Neuron natively integrates into standard neural networks to enable fuzzy logic operations and is available in Keras and PyTorch.
papers.title_ja: 述語ニューロン：勾配ベース学習における述語関係の微分可能量子化
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、深層学習アーキテクチャに記号推論機能を統合するための新しいニューラルモジュール「述語ニューロン」を提案する。一階述語論理の量子化を用いて関係論理をモデル化し、訓練時はハードな論理演算を実行しつつも逆伝播のために微分可能性を維持する独自の勾配メカニズムを導入している。この手法により、標準的な深層学習が苦手とする不連続性や単調推論を含む関数の近似が可能になる。MNISTやWikitextなどのベンチマークで、収束速度の向上、精度の向上、損失の低減が確認され、KerasおよびPyTorchでの利用が可能である。
papers.relevance_reason: 深層学習手法の改良だが、軌道力学やLLM効率化との直接関連は薄い

papers.title: Selective Transfer Learning for Groundwater Level Anomaly Forecasting: Accuracy-Risk Trade-offs
papers.summary: This work studies context-aware selective transfer learning for multi-well groundwater anomaly forecasting in the Netherlands. Source-domain pretraining can raise average accuracy but is not uniformly reliable: it degrades performance on a substantial fraction of heterogeneous wells. Context-Aware Selective Learning (CASL) uses calibration-trained, constrained contextual blending of frozen no-transfer and fixed-transfer parents. Global Convex Blend uses the same parents with one calibration-fitted weight per seed. The corrected task requires nine consecutive observed monthly inputs and an exact three-calendar-month target, without interpolation. Evaluation covers 457 wells and 13,718 test windows under five predefined seeds, with the four-cell maxsim0.60 source pool frozen using Always-TL validation RMSE alone. Fixed transfer harms 18.38-51.86% of wells. CASL has 0.424-1.084% lower RMSE than No TL, partially rescuing 97.53-99.50% and fully rescuing 23.46-43.78% of fixed-harmed wells. Partial rescue can arise structurally from convex blending and does not establish contextual superiority. Global Convex Blend protects more wells in four seeds, while CASL has slightly lower pooled RMSE in four. Neither dominates: the results support an accuracy-risk trade-off on the fixed split, not rolling deployment validity.
papers.title_ja: 地下水水位異常予測のための選択的転移学習：精度とリスクのトレードオフ
papers.summary_ja: オランダの多井戸地下水異常予測において、文脈認識型選択的転移学習（CASL）を提案する。固定転移学習は井戸の約18〜52%で性能を劣化させるが、CASLは凍結させた転移なし・固定転移モデルの凸結合により、劣化した井戸の多くを部分的に救済し、プールされたRMSEをわずかに改善した。ただし、これは文脈優位性を証明するものではなく、精度向上とリスク（性能劣化）のトレードオフを示す結果である。
papers.relevance_reason: 機械学習手法（転移学習・混合）だが、対象が地下水であり軌道力学やLLMとは直接無関係

papers.title: Learning Without Clocks: Partition-Invariant Neural Network
papers.summary: Event cameras, spiking cochleas and similar sensors emit asynchronous events, yet most learning systems first bin them into frames or packets, so the output depends on how the stream was sliced. Networks whose state is updated exactly at every event and evolves in closed form between events are invariant to this slicing. We ask what more makes the output (i) independent of the processing order of simultaneous events and (ii) continuous in the time stamps, even when two events cross in time, while (iii) staying sensitive to temporal order. For arbitrary nonlinear event models we prove that (i) and (ii) are each equivalent to pairwise commutation of the event updates, and that once updates commute, all order dependence comes from their non-commutation with the inter-event dynamics and vanishes linearly in the time lag. This identifies a class of time-mediated non-commutative (TM) models and yields a resolution-robustness bound for any model. We construct the minimal TM layer, a learnable, provably Lipschitz generalization of the Hassenstein-Reichardt correlator; prove that no single additive layer can uniformly represent ordered pair interactions, whereas a three-dimensional TM state can; show that each TM layer adds two levels of temporal nesting versus one for additive layers; and give a single-layer higher-order construction (TM-k) and a stacking rule preserving all three properties. We instantiate these results as the Clock-Free Event (CFE) layer, linear in the number of events, give a topology-free variant for temporal point processes with closed-form likelihoods, and specify a preregistered clock-robustness protocol with a physical-time threat model for spike-retiming attacks. In preliminary development-set experiments, the TM state beats an otherwise identical additive state by 3.5-9.1 points on DVS128 Gesture and by 24.5 and 30.6 points on SHD and Speech Commands.
papers.title_ja: 時計なし学習：分割不変ニューラルネットワーク
papers.summary_ja: イベントカメラ等の非同期データ処理において、フレーム分割やイベント順序に依存しない「分割不変」なニューラルネットワーク層を提案する。任意の非線形イベントモデルに対し、イベント更新の交換可能性と時間連続性の関係を理論的に証明し、時間依存性の非可換性を定式化する。この理論に基づき、Hassenstein-Reichardt相関器の一般化である最小限のTM層を構築し、加算型層では表現できない順序付きペア相互作用を3次元状態空間で表現可能であることを示した。DVS128 Gesture等のタスクにおいて、従来の加算型状態より3.5〜30.6ポイント高い精度を達成し、スパイクタイミング攻撃に対する頑健性も検証した。
papers.relevance_reason: 深層学習の新しいアーキテクチャだが、LLM効率化や軌道力学との直接的な関連は薄い。

papers.title: Depth through Recurrence: Towards Ultra-Efficient On-Device ASR
papers.summary: Modern automatic speech recognition (ASR) systems have achieved remarkable accuracy by scaling model depth and capacity, but at the cost of increased memory, energy, and computational demands. On edge devices where ASR is often most needed, such as watches and glasses, deploying such large models is infeasible due to extremely constrained resources. This raises a fundamental question: can we achieve high representational power in deep ASR models without scaling up parameterization? In this work, we revisit the role of depth and identify layer wise representational dynamics, in which most layers learn functionally similar transformations. Motivated by this insight, we propose a block-recurrent ASR architecture that replaces parameterized depth with a small set of recurrent blocks, each consisting of weight-shared layers, thereby preserving effective depth while drastically reducing model size. Through representation-guided grouping and knowledge distillation, block-recurrent models retain the accuracy of large reference models while using an order of magnitude fewer parameters. Across Open ASR Leaderboard benchmarks, a model with only two shared blocks recovers 97.4% of the accuracy of large models on average. The compact backbone further enables efficient on-device personalization through lightweight MoE-LoRA adaptation, allowing user-specific models to match or surpass the accuracy of general-purpose ASR systems with significantly lower inference cost. By reusing weights across recurrent steps, the proposed architecture reduces memory-access overhead and inference energy consumption. Together, these results show that high quality ASR can be achieved without large parameterization, and that structured recurrence provides a principled path towards ultra-compressed, energy-efficient, and personalized speech recognition on the edge.
papers.title_ja: 再帰による深さ：超効率的なオンデバイスASRへ
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、自動音声認識（ASR）モデルの深さをパラメータ増加なしに実現するブロック再帰型アーキテクチャを提案する。層間の表現動態を分析し、機能的に類似した変換を行う層を特定した上で、重み共有ブロックの再帰的適用によりモデルサイズを大幅に削減する。知識蒸留と表現ガイド型グループ化を用いることで、大規模モデルの97.4%の精度を維持しつつ、パラメータ数を桁違いに減らすことに成功した。さらに、軽量なMoE-LoRA適応により、オンデバイスでのパーソナライズと推論コストの低減を同時に実現している。
papers.relevance_reason: LLM効率化・量子化の手法は関連するが、対象がASR特化のため軌道力学やRAGとの直接の接点は薄い。

papers.title: Investigating the Early Signatures of Feature Learning in Deep Linear Networks
papers.summary: Deep neural networks learn data-dependent features, a capacity widely credited for their empirical success. However, explicitly characterizing what features emerge -- and when they improve generalization -- is challenging, since training is nonlinear and non-convex and the data is often anisotropic. Here, we give a closed-form account of feature learning for a deep linear network in a mean-field parameterization, trained by one gradient step from initialization on high-dimensional data carrying a low-dimensional (spiked) signal. In the infinite-width mean-field limit, one step updates each layer's feature kernel by a target-aligned rank-one spike, amplified by both the learning rate and the layer depth. We next assess how these features impact prediction through kernel ridge regression (KRR), finding that KRR on the learned feature kernel yields scalar inflation of the KRR estimator at initialization -- an "anti-shrinkage" mechanism that reinflates task-relevant directions suppressed by ridge, while also amplifying noise. To study when this inflation improves generalization, in the overparameterized proportional limit we derive closed-form expressions for the bias, variance, and generalization errors of these estimators in terms of key macroscopic parameters -- notably the spike strength and spike-target alignment. Crucially, we find that a one-step generalization advantage vanishes for isotropic inputs and appears when both the spike strength and an effective signal-to-noise ratio are sufficiently large, demonstrating that a successful first gradient step both requires and benefits from low-dimensional task structure.
papers.title_ja: 深層線形ネットワークにおける特徴量学習の初期兆候の調査
papers.summary_ja: 深層線形ネットワークの平均場パラメータ化下で、勾配降下法による1ステップの特徴量学習を閉形式で解析した。学習された特徴量カーネルを用いたカーネルリッジ回帰（KRR）では、リッジによる縮小を打ち消す「アンチ・シュリンク」効果が現れることを示した。過パラメータ化限界下でバイアス・分散・汎化誤差を導出し、各向同性入力では1ステップの汎化利得が消滅するが、スパイク強度と信号対雑音比が十分に大きい低次元構造を持つ場合にのみ利得が現れることを明らかにした。
papers.relevance_reason: 深層学習の理論的基礎だが、ユーザーの関心であるLLM効率化や軌道力学とは直接無関係。

papers.title: An $\Omega(T^{3/4})$ lower bound for projection-free online learning with linear minimization oracles
papers.summary: This work considers projection-free online learning algorithms with linear minimization oracles for handling the decision set. For Online Frank--Wolfe (OFW), regret upper bounds were already known for specific OFW tunings [Hazan and Kale, 2012, Hazan, 2016] which scaled as $T^{3/4}$ (where $T$ is the horizon length). However, it remained an open question whether the regret of all OFW tunings scaled as $T^{3/4}$. We answer that question, proving a universal worst-case regret lower bound $\Omega(T^{3/4} m^{-1/4})$ for any projection-free algorithm that makes at most $m$ linear minimization oracle calls per round. The analysis suggests an extended OFW to resort to multiple linear optimizations per round, for which we prove a regret upper bound $O(\max \{ T^{3/4} m^{-1/4}, \sqrt{T} \})$.
papers.title_ja: 線形最小化オラクルを用いる射影フリーオンライン学習における $\Omega(T^{3/4})$ の下界

papers.title: Finite-Sample Optimal Conformal Prediction Sets under Covariate Shift
papers.summary: We study conformal prediction under covariate shift with a known covariate density ratio, seeking prediction sets with minimum expected length under the target distribution. For every calibration sample size, we prove that the rule combining the inverse conditional-density score with randomized weighted conformal calibration minimizes this expected length among all rules valid over the full weighted-exchangeability class. We approximate the oracle using quantile and kernel histograms, including forest-weighted estimators, and select estimators and tuning parameters by resampling to estimate calibrated target length. On a bounded response domain, we bound excess length linearly in $L^1$ density error at fixed calibration size, without requiring a uniform positive lower bound on the true density. We also bound selection-pool and resampling errors. Under explicit growth conditions, the selected procedure approaches the same oracle while the calibration size remains fixed. Experiments on 36 known-density configurations and four public regression datasets compare coverage, prediction-set length, and runtime with existing methods. In targeted low-coverage and strong-shift comparisons, inverse-density selection yields shorter mean sets in most cases and lower mean runtime than the evaluated weighted baselines, with some differences in achieved coverage.
papers.title_ja: 共変量シフト下における有限サンプル最適なコンフォーマル予測セット

papers.title: Interpretable neural equation learning for high-dimensional materials data
papers.summary: Equation learning seeks to discover compact, interpretable equations from data using various machine-learning techniques. However, few workflows discover and interpret learned equations in sparse, high-dimensional materials datasets. We present nn-EQL, an equation-learning framework that generates candidate equations through iterative training, pruning, and retraining of a neural network with customizable, user-specified neuron-level activation functions. Candidate equations are ranked using a minimum description length (MDL)-inspired score, balancing error and sparsity, and diagnosed to assess term-wise contributions, input-scaled sensitivities, and uncertainties. We demonstrate nn-EQL on standard AI-Feynman benchmarks as well as multiscale high-dimensional materials datasets such as finite-element simulations of heterogeneous materials, and high-throughput experimental thin-film deposition data. nn-EQL integrates with tabular data and high-dimensional data via standard encoder models, learning equations and providing insight into learned terms. Looking forward, integrating physically interpretable representations, multimodal and multi-fidelity data, and adaptive data acquisition could enable equation learning to formulate and test mechanistic hypotheses.

papers.title: When More Planning Hurts: Learned Planners for World Models
papers.summary: On PushT, our fixed action updater (1,505 parameters) solves 8 of 16 scenes reserved from our configuration selection. The comparison planners perform as follows: Selected Adam (7 tasks solved, total planning and encoding time 218.440s), adapted iCEM (2 tasks solved, total planning and encoding time 49.309s), released LePlanner (16 tasks solved, total planning and encoding time 5.652s). The total planning and encoding time for our action updater is 59.079s. Note that our action updater does not satisfy the task-cost criterion we fixed before evaluation. We also conduct another matched experiment where we only replay the first ten commands in each context and then allow the next solve 4, 8 or 12 updates (subsequent solves all get 8 updates). Among all 16 contexts (8 scene clusters), the 3 budgets get 9, 8 and 7 successes, respectively. Interestingly, the extra updates did not rescue any failing task in this experiment. All the changes in success/failure happen in one scene cluster, where we observe that the extra updates decrease the costs of the selected latent world-model trajectories for our updater, while the tasks that used to be successes become failures. papers.title: TERRA: Task-Oriented Edge AI for Regional Fire Detection with Identity-Free Reporting
papers.summary: Distributed fire-monitoring systems may involve many sensing devices reporting over a shared uplink, even though the operational objective is often to identify regions exhibiting evidence of fire rather than to recover device-specific measurements. We introduce TERRA (Task-Oriented Edge Representation and Regional Aggregation), an edge-AI framework that combines task-oriented local inference, identity-free region-tagged reporting, and permutation-invariant regional evidence aggregation. TERRA supports two reporting modes: TERRA-Score, in which each device communicates a quantized local fire probability, and TERRA-Feature, in which it communicates a compact learned representation for receiver-side aggregation using a permutation-invariant DeepSets model. Using all 15 numerical sensing modalities of the distributed indoor EN54 fire-alarm dataset as a proof-of-concept testbed, we evaluate regional inference for an episode-level fire-scenario target under repetition-disjoint three-fold cross-validation. We study representation size, task-payload quantization, report availability, and robustness to missed and false recovered messages. With nine reports and perfect message recovery, TERRA-Feature achieves mean AUPRC 0.990 using a 24-bit task payload, while TERRA-Score achieves 0.987 using only 6 bits; both attain an MDR of 1.81% at FAR $\leq$1%. TERRA-Feature achieves slightly higher AUPRC under reliable recovery, whereas the more compact TERRA-Score is less sensitive to increasing false-message contamination.

papers.title: Learning Lotteries with Minimal Stakeholder Violations from Membership Queries
papers.summary: An AI developer often has several candidate versions of a system and can deploy a mixture of them, sending each request to a randomly chosen version, as in A/B testing. Each stakeholder (e.g., a safety team, a regulator, or a customer with private test data) accepts a mixture exactly when its expected performance (e.g., its rate of harmful replies) meets the stakeholder's own standard, which the developer can learn only by asking whether a proposed mixture is acceptable. We model this as choosing a lottery over $m$ alternatives for $n$ agents, each of whom accepts exactly the lotteries in an unknown halfspace and answers such binary membership queries. While Choo et al. (ICML 2026) sought a lottery that every agent accepts, none may exist when, say, safety and helpfulness requirements conflict, so we minimize the number of rejecting agents. We show that this problem is APX-hard even when all halfspaces are known and all utilities are $0$ or $1$. We then give exact algorithms that run in polynomial time when $m$ is constant, and in quasi-polynomial time when, for a constant $\eta$, some optimal lottery has no accepting agent within $\eta$ of its threshold. When only some agents can be queried, optimizing over a uniform sample of agents gives additive and relative guarantees for the whole population, with a sample size that does not depend on $n$, and a linear program gives a polynomial-time method for any $m$. On the other hand, for $m\ge 3$, a deterministic algorithm that queries only $K$ distinct agents cannot guarantee fewer than $n-K$ extra rejections, and this is achievable; in other words, it can guarantee nothing for the agents it does not ask. Small synthetic experiments indicate that our worst-case bounds are conservative on random instances.
papers.title_ja: メンバーシップクエリを用いたステークホルダー違反の最小化による宝くじの学習

papers.title: SAC-GCL: Structure-Aware Compression for Graph Contrastive Learning
papers.summary: Graph Contrastive Learning (GCL) has achieved remarkable success in self-supervised representation learning by maximizing agreement between augmented views of a graph. Although augmented view generation is the central step in GCL, existing models rely on stochastic augmentation of the input graph, such as edge perturbation and node masking, which lack structural awareness and frequently destroy critical topology or introduce semantically inconsistent views. While recent adaptive methods improve upon random perturbations, they primarily operate on localized node or edge neighborhoods and fail to capture higher-order, macro-level structural organization crucial for graph classification. To address this limitation, we propose Structure-aware Compression for Graph Contrastive Learning (SAC-GCL), a novel framework that employs structural decomposition and graph compression as a principled view generation strategy. Moving beyond random augmentations, SAC-GCL leverages structural decomposition techniques to extract cohesive subgraphs and condense them into supernodes, constructing coarsened graph views that preserve local density and capture higher-level structural patterns while reducing noise and redundancy. We leverage multiple cohesive subgraph models to derive complementary views of the graph, each capturing distinct structural properties. To capture multi-resolution information, a hierarchical view encoder processes these compressed views by initializing super-node features with shared-weight cohesive subgraph embeddings. Our results from extensive experiments on six benchmark datasets demonstrate that structure-aware compression provides a powerful alternative to random perturbations, yielding more robust and discriminative graph representations for graph classification tasks.
papers.title_ja: SAC-GCL: グラフ対照学習のための構造認識型圧縮

papers.title: Responsible Quantum Machine Learning for Medical Imaging: A Fairness Audit Across Sensitive Subgroups
papers.summary: Quantum machine learning (QML) is increasingly explored for medical classification, yet its behaviour under subgroup-aware fairness criteria remains understudied. We present an empirical fairness audit of classical and quantum classifiers for medical imaging, assuming QML is not inherently fair. Two scenarios are evaluated: dermatological lesions on DDI (sensitive attribute: Fitzpatrick skin type) and chest X-rays on CheXpert-derived data (sensitive attribute: age group). Using ResNet-18 embeddings, we train SVM, MLP, QSVM and QCNN under a baseline and three mitigation settings: differentiable Equalized Odds (EO) regularisation, Gradient Reversal Learning (GRL), and both combined. Foundation models (PanDerm, EVA-X) serve as external references. Quantum classifiers may achieve competitive aggregate performance while still exhibiting subgroup disparities. Since a smaller subgroup AUC gap may stem from degrading the best group rather than improving the worst, each mitigation is also tested against a pre-specified non-inferiority margin relative to its baseline. Under this criterion, several configurations with the smallest disparity, notably QCNN with GRL on DDI, are not clinically acceptable due to loss of global discrimination. On DDI, QSVM with GRL+EO performed best and approached PanDerm in the performance/fairness trade-off; on CheXpert, QCNN with GRL achieved the highest aggregate performance but increased disparity, and EVA-X remained stronger. Fairness effects are model- and dataset-dependent, so QML requires empirical subgroup-aware evaluation. All quantum models run in classical simulation; we claim no quantum advantage.

papers.title: Nonlinear springs with orbits in radicals: a solvability criterion
papers.summary: An odd polynomial oscillator has a periodic orbit given by a quadrature. When the zeros of the energy polynomial are all simple or all of even multiplicity, that quadrature is elementary exactly when the polynomial is a perfect square, and the time is a sum of inverse tangents. Recovering the displacement inverts that relation, algebraic when their coefficients are commensurate, making a closed form a Galois question. This paper identifies the group as the monodromy group of a rational map, computes its branch data from the parameters, and shows the branch value at the phase-angle singularity never vanishes, so every decomposition pairs the amplitudes reciprocally. In the commensurate family with distinct real factors, the orbit is radical exactly when the primitive inversion degree is at most four, or when reciprocal pairs leave a reduced spring of that degree. Radical orbits occur at the fifth, ninth, thirteenth and seventeenth force orders, the last only for reciprocal members, an expression recorded for each. The multiplicity hypothesis cannot be dropped. Factoring the energy polynomial into square and squarefree parts turns the quadrature into a differential of the third kind on a hyperelliptic curve, where elementarity is a torsion condition on the divisor of its poles with a vanishing holomorphic remainder. The first nonsquare elementary member appears at the ninth force order, and the power pullback inverts in closed form at every such order, giving a radical orbit for a confining spring of arbitrarily high degree with a sufficient condition for positive coefficients.
papers.title_ja: ラジカルで軌道を持つ非線形ばね：可解性基準

papers.title: Symmetry-resolved periods in a cyclic-dominance automaton: separating intrinsic from lattice-induced periodicity
papers.summary: Periodic attractors of spatially extended systems possess not one period but a hierarchy of periods, one for each level of observation and symmetry quotient, and this hierarchy separates how a pattern evolves from how it fits the finite domain. For a synchronous threshold model of cyclic dominance on an $L\times L$ torus, equivalent to the three-color cyclic cellular automaton of Fisch, Gravner and Griffeath, we measure for every attractor a \emph{tuple} of periods: that of the populations ($\Tpop$), of the full configuration ($\Tst$), and of the configuration up to color rotations ($\Tcol$), lattice symmetries ($\Tgeo$) and the full space--color group ($\TG$). Equivariance implies exact divisibility relations and the factorization $\Tst=\TG\,m$, where $m$ counts the applications of the symmetry $h$ that maps the configuration onto itself after $\TG$ steps: $\TG$ and the type of $h$ belong to the pattern, $m$ to the lattice, and the attractors are relative periodic orbits whose full period emerges from the interaction between the intrinsic dynamics and the lattice symmetries. A family of attractors built around a pair of counter-rotating spirals, with $\Tpop=24$ and $\TG=8$, persists from $L=9$ to $L=40$ while $\Tst$ takes values from 24 to 960, given in every case by the order of $h$; on a rectangular $9\times12$ torus it takes the value 48, absent from all square tori. With more than $4.5\times10^5$ runs at each of $L=8$ and $L=9$ we estimate the basins of attraction: fixed points take 95--97\% of the configuration space, and no single period is enough to tell the oscillating attractors apart. The same analysis locates local diversity: it is balanced whenever the cycle has a color symmetry and, on large lattices, it is concentrated at the spiral cores.

papers.title: The Korean Space Telescope (KST): A Dedicated Space Observatory for the Dark Universe
papers.summary: The Korean Space Telescope (KST) is a next-generation 1.4-meter wide-field space observatory, a dedicated probe of the dark sector. Its single instrument provides diffraction-limited visible imaging (~0.15 arcsec in the optical) together with simultaneous near-infrared (R ~ 100) slitless spectrophotometry, so that every detected source is observed in the NIR by the survey itself, with spectral information delivered at a resolution set by its brightness (full R ~ 100 typing at the bright end, synthetic medium-band or broadband photometry below it) and with no separate follow-up, a capability decisive for time-domain science. With it, KST addresses the three outstanding questions of dark physics in concert: the dynamics of dark energy, the nature of dark matter, and gravitational-wave dark sirens as independent cosmological rulers. KST combines measurements of expansion and structure growth to test dark-energy models. A two-tiered "Wedding Cake" strategy (2,000 deg^2 Wide plus 10 deg^2 cluster-targeted Deep Survey) combines weak lensing, baryon acoustic oscillations, and a near-infrared-standardized Type Ia supernova Hubble diagram to constrain dark energy at its pivot redshift (sigma(w_p) ~ 0.03); maps dark matter from cluster cores to galactic substructure to test cold dark matter against warm and self-interacting alternatives; and builds a deep near-infrared host catalog for a distance-ladder-independent H_0 from dark sirens. The same data yield a Legacy Science portfolio (galaxy evolution, active galactic nuclei, exoplanets, and the Milky Way) at no additional observing cost. As Korea's first dedicated astrophysics space mission, KST occupies a niche complementary to the Vera C. Rubin Observatory, Euclid, and Roman.
